title: Closing and train ride
summary: Goodbyes and confirming his ride to the train.

blocks.x: Well on that note, we’re going to get you to your train.
We’re in good shape here, so it’s been a real pleasure.
But wait, they’re supposed to be here. They have my horn and my stuff.
Monk, thank you man, it was fun, really. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
